root_cause.text: The bpf_xdp_store_bytes helper's prototype incorrectly set its source buffer argument type to ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM (which implies writable memory) instead of a read-only pointer, causing the verifier to reject read-only map values and potentially allowing reads from uninitialized memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes arg3_type from `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM` to `ARG_PTR_TO_MEM | MEM_RDONLY`; the CVE description states that the third argument had expected type `ARG_PTR_TO_UNINIT_MEM`, which includes the MEM_WRITE flag, leading to a "write into map forbidden" error when using read-only maps, and that it "can also lead to the helper reading from uninitialized memory."
